deadline.value: The Fall application deadline is March 1; later applications are considered on a space-available basis.

gre_subject.value: No subject test applies to engineering.

toefl_min.value: The college requires TOEFL iBT 79, above the graduate-school default of 71.

ielts_min.value: The college requires IELTS 6.5, above the graduate-school default of 6.0.

supervisor.value: The pages fetched do not say whether an advisor is needed before admission.

funding.value: The pages fetched do not state a funding rule for admitted PhD students.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's graduates can apply, and master's holders can enter on a shorter credit path.
entry_route.quote: Minimum Total Credit Hours for Post-Master’s Students

also.quote: Bachelor's or master's degree in mechatronics engineering or closely related area

notes: One record for two Ph.D.s in the College of Aeronautics and Engineering: Aerospace Engineering (page above) and Mechatronics Engineering (kent.edu/engineering/mechatronics-engineering-phd). Both share the March 1 deadline and 79/6.5 minimums. The GRE is not mentioned on either page.
name: Aerospace Engineering and Mechatronics Engineering (Ph.D.)
